writes.how: Kumi Rust writer created a new named patch from init, enabled oscillator B, set its level to 0.45 and coarse pitch to +12 semitones, and added Distortion. Both VST3 state halves were loaded into a fresh installed 2.1.5 instance using standard host APIs. Parameter readback confirmed enabled B, level sqrt(0.45) on its normalized host curve and +12 semitones; saved processor state retained the Distortion slot. This verifies serialization and these controls, not every DSP parameter.
